name: iso-intelligent-memory
title: Iso Intelligent Memory
description: A pixel-faithful isometric illustration suggesting auto-saving memory into a structured store. Features a 3x3x3 cuboid cluster with a brand-orange vertical spine (plus-shaped middle layer, base + cap centers), trailing particle dots on both sides, a subtle grid plate, and an auto-saved status pill. Pure inline SVG, no dependencies, true 2:1 isometric projection.
